reassurance_anchor.text_en: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.

verses.translation_en: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.

socratic_dropdowns.question: Where was this said?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: In the cave of Thawr, during the Hijrah. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and Abu Bakr were together in the cave after being driven out by those who disbelieved.

evidence.arabic: إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَاحِبِهِ لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا
evidence.translation_en: When he said to his companion, 'Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.'
And Allah sent down His calmness upon him.

evidence.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
evidence.translation_en: It is He who sent down calmness into the hearts of the believers.

verses.translation_en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.

socratic_dropdowns.question: Why 'with' and not 'after'?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: The Quran uses 'with'. Ease is placed with hardship. They are intertwined.

evidence.translation_en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.

evidence.arabic: يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ بِكُمُ الْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ الْعُسْرَ
evidence.translation_en: Allah intends for you ease and does not intend for you hardship.

verses.translation_en: Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor has He become displeased.

socratic_dropdowns.question: Why was this verse revealed?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: The Prophet ﷺ had not received revelation for some time. The disbelievers mocked him, saying that his Lord had abandoned him. This verse answered them.

evidence.translation_en: Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor has He become displeased.
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

verses.translation_en: And give good tidings to the patient.

socratic_dropdowns.question: What are the good tidings?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: The verses that follow describe them: blessings and mercy.

evidence.arabic: الَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Who, when disaster strikes them, say, 'Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.'

evidence.arabic: أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ
evidence.translation_en: Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy.

verses.translation_en: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

socratic_dropdowns.question: Who is this verse addressed to?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: It is addressed to those who have transgressed against themselves. It is a call to return.

evidence.arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ
evidence.translation_en: Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves.'
Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
